Context: 2. Earned Leave

7. If a Government servant retires/resigns/Is removed/is dismissed! dies in the middle of a calendar year, the earned leave credited should be reduced at the rate of Yio th of any extraordinary leave taken in that half-year and the leave account regularized. - GID (1), Rule 27.
8. While affording credit, fractions of a day should be rounded off to the nearest day, e.g. 7 Yi. days to be rounded as 8 days. - Rule :27 c(4).
